For every payment key, link it to a trusted observed service event only when current facts explicitly say the payment is for that service and exactly one observed_related_source_events entry matches the actual worker, employer, and literal service kind. Use that actual event ID as purpose_service_key. All four purpose fields are null only when a complete source scan finds no payment purpose. Multiple or partial matches are unread; never create a service key or use a query value.
Read facts only. Preserve current source keys. Do not infer missing dates, people or places. Complete scans enumerate every relevant source record. Ambiguity is unread. Return the named relation wrapper.
